responsibility: Provides the backend support layer that turns codegen results into finished native artifacts. This module groups the machinery for coordinating optimization and object emission work across codegen units and LTO, packaging metadata into object containers, computing exported symbols and runtime library search paths, building and rewriting native archives, constructing and recording linker commands through target-specific linker abstractions, and driving the final link step to produce binaries, libraries, and related platform-specific outputs; `mod.rs` ties these backend areas together and exposes shared target-triple selection helpers, while `rpath/tests.rs` validates the runtime library path construction logic.
